skills.name: Withering Hex
skills.text: Curse a foe within {range} tiles with creeping rot: {dot} Blight damage per stack each turn for {turns} turns. Casting it again on the same foe adds a stack, up to {stacks}, and refreshes the curse.

variants.name: Contagion
variants.text: When the cursed foe dies, the curse leaps to every foe within {spread} tile of the body, stacks and all.

variants.name: Rot
variants.text: The cursed foe's armour falls by {armourCut}%.

variants.name: Hunger
variants.text: You heal for {healPct}% of the Blight damage the curse deals.

skills.name: Malign Study
skills.text: Your curses last {curseTurns} turns longer. At rank 5 a foe can carry one more curse.

skills.name: Hex of Frailty
skills.text: Hex every foe within {radius} tile of a cell up to {range} tiles away. For {turns} turns they are Vulnerable and take {takenPct}% more damage.

variants.name: Brittle Bones
variants.text: Hexed foes also take {critTakenPct}% more damage from critical hits.

variants.name: Gaze
variants.text: The hex falls on a single foe instead, and it takes {takenPct}% more damage.

skills.name: Evil Eye
skills.text: Fix a foe within {range} tiles with the Evil Eye: it takes {dmg} Blight damage and is Feared for {fearTurns} turns.

variants.name: Dread
variants.text: The gaze also falls on every foe within {radius} tile of the target.

variants.name: Unseeing
variants.text: Instead of fear, the foe is Blinded for {blindTurns} turns.

variants.name: Paralysis
variants.text: Instead of fear, the foe is Stunned for {stunTurns} turn.

skills.name: Pox Swarm
skills.text: Loose a swarm of pox-flies on a foe within {range} tiles. Each turn it bites its host for {dot} Blight damage, then hops to the nearest other foe within {hop} tiles. The swarm lasts {turns} turns.

variants.name: Locusts
variants.text: The swarm hops {hops} times each turn, biting for {hopPct}% of its damage at every stop.

variants.name: Mothsight
variants.text: Every foe the swarm bites is Blinded for {blindTurns} turns.

variants.name: Gravefly
variants.text: The first time a bite kills, a second swarm rises from the body.

skills.name: Accursed
skills.text: Cursed foes take {dmgPct}% more damage from every source for each curse they carry.

skills.name: Doom
skills.text: Pronounce Doom on a foe within {range} tiles. After {turns} turns it suffers {dmg} Blight damage plus {storedPct}% of all the damage it took while Doomed. A violet countdown above it shows the turns left and the damage stored.

variants.name: Shared Doom
variants.text: When Doom falls, it strikes every foe within {radius} tiles of the target.

variants.name: Inevitable
variants.text: Doom cannot be cleansed, and it deals {bossPct}% more damage to bosses.

skills.name: Tongue of Malice
skills.text: Every curse on a foe lowers all of its resistances by {resistCut}%.

strings.tree.desc: Lay curses on your foes and let them rot, then cash the curses in with Doom.
strings.curse.name: Cursed
strings.curse.desc: A hex clings to this creature. Once it carries all the curses it can, each new one drives out the oldest.
strings.buff.withering.name: Withering Hex
strings.buff.withering.desc: Rot eats at this creature: {dot} Blight damage each turn for {turns} more turns, and every wound heals at half the pace. Stacks: {stacks}.
strings.buff.frailty.name: Hex of Frailty
strings.buff.frailty.desc: This creature's flesh has turned traitor: it takes {pct}% more damage from every source for {turns} more turns.
strings.buff.evil_eye.name: Evil Eye
strings.buff.evil_eye.desc: A baleful gaze has settled on this creature. It lingers for {turns} more turns.
strings.buff.pox_swarm.name: Pox Swarm
strings.buff.pox_swarm.desc: Pox-flies feed on this creature for {dot} Blight damage each turn. When they have fed, they seek another host. Turns left: {turns}.
strings.buff.doom.name: Doom
strings.buff.doom.desc: Doom gathers over this creature. In {turns} turns it falls as Blight damage for everything stored: {dmg} so far, and every wound it takes until then adds to it.
strings.log.contagion: The curse leaps to fresh hosts.
strings.log.gravefly: A new swarm rises from the body.
strings.refuse.no_foe: No foe stands within the hex.
